send_rules.links_per_email: 2 max: one Loom, one portfolio. No tracking redirects.
send_rules.attach_resume: Only when applying to a posted role. Skip it for founder cold emails and offer to send it instead.
send_rules.daily_volume: 20 to 30 new emails a day from personal Gmail, spread over the day. Never 100 in one burst.
send_rules.follow_ups: Reply in the same thread on day 3 or 4 (second Loom), then day 8 (short close-out).
send_rules.custom_hook: Must be a real sentence fragment about their product, written by a human or checked by one. Never 'what you are building at X (linkedin url, city)'.
send_rules.best_send_time: Tuesday to Thursday, 8 to 10 AM in the recipient's timezone
send_rules.paid_only: Offer a small paid trial, never free work. It signals you value your time and filters out people who will not pay 20K+.

job_search.min_compensation: Above INR 20,000 per month (current stipend is INR 20,000). Do not mention pay in the first email, settle it on the call.
job_search.good_targets: Seed to Series B startups, AI agencies and automation shops that hire remote in India, or remote-first global teams with open roles on Wellfound, YC Work at a Startup, LinkedIn or X hiring posts.
skip: CEOs of 100+ person companies (email the hiring manager or engineering lead instead)
Generic inboxes like hello@, info@, founders@
